title: skill-scanner configuration
description: ~/.skill-scanner/config.json, or a file passed with --config. skill-scanner never reads configuration from the directory it scans.

blockAt.description: Block when any finding's effective severity reaches this. Low-confidence findings count one level lower.

warnAt.description: Warn when any finding's effective severity reaches this.

ignore.description: Findings to suppress before the verdict.

rule.description: A rule id such as exec/download-and-run, a category wildcard such as network/*, or *.

path.description: Glob over finding paths (*, **, ?). Omit for every path.

digest.description: Only for this exact skill content, as shown in reports.

reason.description: Why this is suppressed, for the next reader.

judge.description: The optional jev judge. Off unless enabled here or with --judge; it sends redacted skill text to the provider.

provider.description: Force a provider. By default the key's prefix decides.

model.description: Override the provider's default jev model id.

baseUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint override; plain HTTP only for localhost.

analyzers.description: External open-source analyzers to run when installed. All off by default.

semgrepConfig.description: Semgrep or opengrep --config value. A local path keeps the scan offline; a registry ruleset such as p/default uses the network.

hooks.description: How harness hooks and plugins act on install scans.

onWarn.description: When an install scans as warn.

onError.description: When the scan itself fails, for example a network error while fetching the source.

quarantine.description: Move skills found blocked after install to ~/.skill-scanner/quarantine.
